query: UPDATE notifications SET updated_at = $1, message_id = COALESCE($2, message_id), thread_id = COALESCE($3, thread_id), render_hash = COALESCE($4, render_hash), applied_tags = COALESCE($5, applied_tags), tags_hash = COALESCE($6, tags_hash), pinned = COALESCE($7, pinned), archived = COALESCE($8, archived) WHERE id = $9
